coverage.note: Totals, days, models and projects are read from the durable activity database and cover 2026-03-08 through 2026-10-16 (UTC days). The database started recording on 2026-07-07. From before that date it holds only the sessions whose logs were still on disk that day, so the earlier months are incomplete and nothing before 2026-03-08 is included.

definitions.message: One transcript record: a prompt, a tool result, or one content block of a model reply. Not a count of prompts typed.
definitions.session: One Claude Code session log. Subagent logs are not counted.
definitions.project: The directory a session started in, by its last path component.
definitions.tokens: Counted once per model response, not once per log line. The record does not store response ids, so a response is reconstructed from the usage counts its log lines repeat. On 2026-10-02 that rule was compared with response ids in the raw logs still on disk, about 40 percent of the record, and gave identical counts and token sums. The other 60 percent, whose logs were already pruned, is counted by the same rule and was not verified. Tokens used by subagents are not in the record.

rollingWindow.note: Keyword and technology mentions need message text, which the database does not store. They are counted over a sample of the raw session logs still on disk (about the last 30 days) plus the CLAUDE.md and plan files, so they describe recent work, not the whole record.
